_: What `just acknowledgements` (internal/acknowledgements/gen) can't find in a lock file, and how it
names what it does find. It finds by itself: the Go modules linked into hmk, hmkd and pane-holder (for
macOS and Linux), the Swift packages in apple/Package.resolved, the npm packages bundled into
apple/Resources/editor.html, and the rows of THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The licence texts come from those
packages' own files, never typed here. {ghostty_src}, {cef_dir}, {goroot} and {repo} are filled in by it;
{ghostty}, {cef} and {go} are their versions. A missing file stops it: fix the path here (a new Ghostty
commit can move its dependencies' folders in {ghostty_src}/zig-pkg).
